name: Amor
overview: Amor is a male figure identified as a son of Canaan and a member of the Amorite tribe. His mention in Scripture situates him within the early genealogies of the descendants of Canaan, highlighting his ethnic and tribal identity. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Amor' appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:16. No specific meaning or divine origin is attributed to this name in the biblical text, so it is presented plainly as a tribal patriarchal name.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Amor as a son of Canaan, linking him directly to the Canaanite lineage. Additionally, he is connected by inference as an ancestor to figures such as Mamre, Eshcol, Aner, and Sihon, indicating his role as a progenitor within the Amorite tribal network.
scriptureSignificance: Amor's significance lies in his place within the genealogical framework of the Canaanite peoples, serving as a foundational ancestor of the Amorite tribe. His descendants appear in various biblical narratives, marking the Amorites as a distinct group encountered by Israel. This genealogical placement underscores the fulfillment of God's promises regarding the nations and their territories in the land promised to Abraham's descendants.
